about: Shot list for the ≤2:00 video (docs/pitch/VIDEO.md). Deck shots open docs/pitch/deck.html locally (file://…/deck.html#sN, needs network for fonts and Motion; without it slides still render). App shots run on the final deploy in a fresh profile at 1920x1080. waitFor strings are the visible text to wait for; where the UI label differs on the final deploy, use the real one and note it. durationS is the length to keep in the cut; record ~2x that and the editor trims.
